We can now save our processed data.

```{r}
write_new_dirs(paste0(path_to_output_1L_chr,"/R"),
                       consent_1L_chr = "Y")
```

We save a copy of our processed dataset.

```{r message=FALSE}
saveRDS(processed_tb, 
        paste0(path_to_output_1L_chr,"/",
               "/R/processed_tb.RDS"))
```
